info.name: TurboLedger — Phase 5 (Deposits)
info.description:
Phase 5 surface through the API Gateway: savingsaccounts, savingsproducts, fixeddepositaccounts, fixeddepositproducts, recurringdepositaccounts, recurringdepositproducts, interestratecharts, accounttransfers, standinginstructions (incl. run history), accountnumberformats, and charges (DepositAccountManagement service).

Run the '0 - Auth' request first (requires a tenant/admin already provisioned) to populate {{token}}. Collection variables: baseUrl, tenantId, token.

Request bodies were auto-derived from the actual field reads in DepositAccountManagementService.cc; placeholder values are generic and should be adjusted to valid data (e.g. real product/office/charge ids) for your environment.

Note: Fineract's separate FD/RD endpoint families are served by this same service off the shared savings_account/savings_product tables via a deposit_type discriminator — the fixeddeposit*/recurringdeposit* folders hit dedicated controllers/paths but the same underlying command dispatch as savingsaccounts. GSIM (Group Savings) endpoints are a documented scope trim (return 501) and are not included here; Share-account routes are out of scope for this phase.
